about.title: A local family, at your service since 1998.
about.body1: Naxos Auto Rent is a family-run car rental company based in Galanado, in the heart of Naxos. For over two decades we've helped travellers from all over the world discover the island the way it's meant to be seen, freely, at their own pace.
about.body2: We're not a faceless international chain. When you rent with us, you're supported by real local people who know every beach, every village and every road on Naxos, and who genuinely want your trip to be unforgettable.
about.body3: That's why so many of our guests come back, and why they send their friends. Rent local, support a real Naxian family, and travel with people who treat you like a neighbour.

faq.title: Everything you need to know.
faq.subtitle: Can't find your answer? Call or WhatsApp us any time, we're here 24/7.

insured.a: Yes. All Naxos Auto Rent vehicles are insured against liability to third parties (TPI). You can add a Collision Damage Waiver (CDW) for a small daily charge for extra peace of mind.

accident.q: What if I'm in an accident or the car is damaged?
accident.a: First, make sure you're safe and away from traffic. Then call the 24-hour number on your rental contract and we'll guide you through the whole process. In case of injury, always call the Greek police.

pickup.q: Where can I collect and return the car?
pickup.a: You can collect from Naxos Port, Naxos Airport, or we can deliver the car to your accommodation. The car is returned to an agreed location, all delivery and collection is free.

breakdown.q: What if the car breaks down?
breakdown.a: Our vehicles are highly maintained to avoid mechanical issues. If you do have a breakdown, we provide 24-hour road assistance and an immediate replacement so you can continue your trip.

payment.a: You can pay by cash, PayPal, bank transfer or credit card.

howToRent.q: How do I rent a car?
howToRent.a: Rent in 3 steps using our online booking engine, via the contact form, or by calling +30 693 099 3670. If you book online, we'll contact you to confirm your reservation.

contactTime.a: You can reach us 24/7 by phone on +30 693 099 3670 or +30 697 443 0785.

fines.q: Who is responsible for parking fines or traffic violations?
fines.a: You are responsible for any parking fines or traffic violations during your rental period.
